title: Blockwise Stabilized Adaptive Cubic Regularization with Subsolvers via Recurrence
summary: Overparameterized networks often have ill-conditioned, saddle rich loss landscapes. They are usually trained with first-order methods that struggle on those landscapes, while many second-order methods stay infeasible at scale. Some scalable cubic methods replace the Hessian by a computationally cheap approximation and drop the exact block curvature. This paper introduces ARC-block, a blockwise adaptive regularization with cubics (ARC) optimizer.
